tools.name: list_sources_for

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_clubs, get_club, list_sources_for · Private data: search_clubs · Public sink: request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_clubs, get_club, list_sources_for · Private data: search_clubs · Public sink: request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_clubs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search approved golf clubs/courses in Spain (Canary Islands first, mainland Spain being added). Returns summary records (last_verified; no sources[]); call get_club or list_sources_for for provenance before citing." → after: "Search verified golf clubs and courses across Europe (e.g. GB, DE, FR, ES, SE, IE, NL, IT, PT) by a free-text fragment (matches name, island, municipality or region), and/or ISO country code, island, region and municipality filters. Returns summary records (country, island, region, holes, green fee "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
